title: A C¹ immersion of an open subset of ℝ^m into an m-dimensional subspace has relatively open image (parent step 4)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let H ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim H = m (Module.finrank ℝ H = m), let B ⊆ ℝ^m be open and let ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^P be of class C¹ on B, with Dψ(v) = fderiv ℝ ψ v injective for every v ∈ B and ψ(B) ⊆ H. Then there is an open set O ⊆ ℝ^P with O ∩ H = ψ(B); that is, ψ(B) is relatively open in H.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (H : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (B : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ H = m → IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ B → (∀ v ∈ B, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ v)) → ψ '' B ⊆ (H : Set (Euclid P)) → ∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ O ∩ (H : Set (Euclid P)) = ψ '' B
